name: Order Subdomain (Subdomain of Law)
body:
Replacement Power: The following power replaces the touch of law domain power (for Law domain).

Order’s Smite (Su)

You can confidentially wield order’s might: this is a supernatural ability to make a single melee attack with a morale bonus to the attack and damage roll equal to 1 + 1/4 your cleric level (minimum +1). You must declare the order’s smite before making the attack. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier, no more than once per round.

Replacement Domain Spells: 1st–command; 2nd-calculative mind; 3rd-mantle of order; 6th-wall of clockwork; 9th–gate*

* This version of gate can only be used to call extraplanar creatures that are always LN, possess the lawful subtype, and the HD sum of the called creatures cannot be greater than 25 HD. Such called creatures will perform one duty that you request; the requested duty that cannot take longer than 1 hour to complete or serve and it cannot be a request that goes against the called creature’s nature nor violate any of your deity’s edicts. The cost of the payment for the duty is waived.
